verdict.rationale: UK Visas and Immigration runs online digital services, so a built-in AI assistant is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence covers only conventional online tools: a visa-finder tool, online applications, the ID Check app, processing-time lookups and email alerts. Nothing shows a built-in AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
